title: Green Hydrogen, Explained
cta: Ask your teacher how your town could use clean energy.

segments.text: What if a fuel could come from water and sunshine?
That is the idea behind green hydrogen.
Green hydrogen is made by electrolysis, using electricity from wind or solar power.
An electric current splits water into hydrogen and oxygen.
It can help industries that are hard to run on electricity, like making steel and fertiliser.
It can also store renewable energy for later and power fuel cell vehicles.
But right now it costs more to make than hydrogen from natural gas.
And making it loses some energy, so it is less efficient than using electricity directly.
Ask your teacher how your town could use clean energy.
